required_formats: 三事项证据表（事项、发现、范围、数值/原文、来源URL或笔记ID、发布日期、数据期间、访问日期、核验状态）
支持材料/反对材料/未解决缺口分开写
区分观察事实、条件计算、推断

## 4. 事实、条件计算与推断的区分

time_periods.period: latest two complete comparable annual periods up to 2026-10-30
time_periods.primary_source: published suburb/house statistics (e.g. REIWA, Landgate, Cotality/CoreLogic, SQM, Domain, realestate.com.au)

scope_conditions: 1 km straight-line radius around the address as working default; suburb stats shown separately; postcode 6164 only auxiliary
only three topics investigated; not full risk assessment
negative-equity calc is static, excludes transaction costs/taxes, loan fixed
no guaranteed return or definite buy advice

levers.domain_notes: Sourcing: primary/authoritative property data first (Landgate, REIWA, state/ABS, Cotality, SQM Research, Domain, realestate.com.au) with explicit data periods; most pages are JS-heavy or paywalled so record fetch failures. Evidence norms: sold-price medians with sample sizes outrank asking prices and commentary; suburb medians are background only. Recency: only data published on or before 2026-10-30 counts.

rationale.register: query asks for supporting/opposing evidence and gaps, coverage-shaped with explicit no-verdict boundary
rationale.inference_depth: bounded three-item evidence collection; gaps are reported rather than inferred
